# fixture-project agent router

Owner: fixture maintainer

This is a filled instance of `docs/AGENTS-TEMPLATE.md` for the WP-07 paired
test. It is an eval fixture, not a second canonical template.

## Commands

Run from the repository root.

```bash
make build          # build
make test           # test (one file: make test FILE=src/x_test.py)
make lint           # lint and format check
make gate           # full check before handoff
```

## Conventions

- One writer per branch; do not edit `dist/`, it is generated by `make build`.
- Application code lives in `src/`; tooling lives in `scripts/`; do not cross
  the boundary.
- Forbidden: `.env` and any `*.pem`; report environment variable names only.

## Verification

- Done means `make gate` exits 0; prove it with `make gate`.
- Trap: `make test` needs `FIXTURE_DB` set; it flaked once under parallel load.

## Pointers

- Rules: `docs/standards.md`
- Skills: `skills/SKILLS.md`
- Runbooks: `docs/runbooks/`
- CI gates: `.forgejo/workflows/`
